rationale: param_efficient-claude-agentic: reg_type=bilateral, bilateral_on_top=False, proj_filter_on=False, n_iter=30, learnable_alpha=True, alpha_init=0.1, foe_n_filters=24, foe_kernel=7, foe_n_bumps=31, n_bf=1, bf_multiscale=True, bf_sigmas=[0.8, 1.6, 3.2], bf_kernel=7, bf_sigma_r=0.02, bf_gain_init=0.0, epochs=16, cosine_lr=True, lr=0.005, max_train_s=1080, batch_size=4, train_n=200, val_n=200, display_min=0.0, display_max=0.05, seed=42, rationale=iter-17 param_efficient breast -- ADD SINOGRAM-SPACE DUAL term (true primal-dual, last distinct lever). SIX-BOX: (1) PRIOR: LPD learned-combination W=4 = 0.5047 @ 183p CHAMPION; W=8 (iter-16) REGRESSED to 0.4754 -> conv width saturated at W=4. The image-space LPD-combine learns the PRIMAL update but has NO dual half -- it back-projects the RAW residual (Rx-g). LPD's 0.68 uses BOTH a primal AND a learned DUAL operating in measurement space. (2) FAILURE MODE: pure image-space combination can't learn to precondition/route the residual in SINOGRAM space where sparse-view inconsistency lives. (3) ONE KNOB (architectural): lpd_dual=True -- I added a minimal DualUpdate block: a tied 2-layer 3x3 conv f(resid,h_dual)->h_dual (2->Wd=4->1, 113 params) with a persistent SINOGRAM-space dual memory h, applied to resid=Rx-g BEFORE the filtered back-projection (dc=fbp(h) uses the LEARNED dual residual). Final layer zero-init => h==resid at init => dc==fbp(resid)==iter-15 BYTE-FOR-BYTE (worst case == 0.5047, no regression). Total ~= 149(primal) + 113(dual) + 30(alpha) + 4(unused) ~= 296 params. (4) HYPOTHESIS: a learned dual that preconditions the residual in measurement space (the true primal-dual structure) lets the unroll route sparse-view inconsistency where it lives -> hr climbs past 0.5047 toward VN 0.63 / LPD 0.68, at ~296 params. (5) BUDGET: +1 tiny sinogram conv/step (sinogram is A*D ~ 128*736, similar cost to the image conv); iter-15 finished 16ep in 1020s -> expect ~14-16ep in the 1080s wall; train_n=200, --time=00:30:00, 200-val -> 20-min comparable. (6) SERIAL; iter-18: if dual helps, tune Wd / grow; if not, 0.5047 @ 183p is the honest champion -> begin final report + seed replicates for mean+-std., dc_mode=filtered, per_step_alpha=True, lpd_on=True, lpd_width=4, lpd_kernel=3, anisotropic_on_top=False, lpd_dual=True, lpd_dual_width=4
